notes: DCA obligations: present_need=163, prospective_need=126 (both accepted Jan 14, 2025). Village applied for Vacant Land Adjustment — only 0.55 acres viable vacant land identified; RDP = 0. Third Round JOR: December 30, 2024. Must address at least 25% of adjusted prospective obligation = at least 32 units through rezoning/redevelopment. Village plans total 105 new affordable units (if all built) + 22 carryover from Lombardi Towers = 127 units. Challenger Road Redevelopment District (4 projects) are 3rd Round mechanisms providing ongoing 4th Round credits. New Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area sites (30 Mt. Vernon, 36 Mt. Vernon, Disability Assoc., Lincoln Court, Elks Club) are 4th Round mechanisms. Challenger Road overlay sites (Samsung, AMC Theatre) are additional unmet need. Candidate snapshot had prospective=126 (correct) but rdp listed as null (correct, RDP=0). Candidate had 4 sites vs. 13 actual sites documented.

sources.title: Village of Ridgefield Park Fourth Round Housing Element and Fair Share Plan (June 10, 2025; adopted June 23, 2025)
sources.excerpt: The Village of Ridgefield Park's prospective need for affordable housing obligation for the Fourth Round is 126. However, the Village is applying for a vacant land adjustment as it lacks sufficient land to address its Fourth-Round obligation. ... In totality, the Village's review resulted in potential developable land being a total of 0.55 acres within the Village. Therefore, the Village is requesting a vacant land adjustment that would result in a realistic development potential (RDP) of 0.

sites.quote: The 9-13 Lincoln Avenue development was constructed and now provides four affordable units, two one-bedroom and two two-bedroom units. ... The deed restrictions for the four affordable units (30 years) have been filed and are included in appendix XIV.
sites.notes: 3rd Round project now complete. 4 affordable units (2x1BR, 2x2BR); 30-year deed restrictions filed. One 3-BR unit was transferred to 60 Challenger Road project per agreement. Block/lot not stated in HEFSP for this site.

sites.quote: The project at 95 Challenger Road is most likely to begin construction this year (2025). The project will result in 22 affordable units with a 30-year deed restriction for the rental units, as it was previously approved prior to the imposition of the Court's new Uniform Housing Affordability Controls ('UHAC'). An application has been made to the Village for footing and foundation permits.
sites.notes: 3rd Round project. ~216 total units. 22 affordable units; 30-year deed restrictions. Application for footing/foundation permits filed. Construction likely 2025/2026. Block/lot not stated in HEFSP for this site.

sites.quote: The project at 64 Challenger Road is likely to follow 95 Challenger Road. The project requires NJDEP permitting and remediation for an existing landfill on the property. ... The development proposes 600 residential units in two phases with 60 affordable units. These units will also be subject to a 30-year deed restriction.
sites.notes: 3rd Round project. 600 total units in two phases; 60 affordable (10% set-aside); 30-year deed restrictions. NJDEP remediation required (existing landfill). Village anticipates construction 2028-2029. Block/lot not stated in HEFSP.

sites.quote: The project at 60 Challenger Road was approved for 552 residential units in 2020. The Village Planning Board has granted an extension of the site plan approvals to 2026. The project will provide 56 affordable units and the addition of one three-bedroom unit from the 9-13 Lincoln project.
sites.notes: 3rd Round project. 552 total units; 56 affordable + 1 transferred 3-BR from Lincoln Avenue = 57 affordable total. Site plan approvals extended to 2026. Block 24.04 Lot 1 identified in VLA analysis appendix. Scheduled for construction 2031-2033.

sites.site_name: 30 Mt. Vernon Street (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area)
sites.address: 30 Mt. Vernon Street (intersection of Mt. Vernon Street and Lincoln Avenue)
sites.source_page: p. 16 (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan section)
sites.quote: 30 Mt. Vernon Street (Block 64 Lot 12) – 6 units. This property lies at the intersection of Mt. Vernon Street and Lincoln Avenue (Block 64 Lot 12). It is 0.25 acres in size and is currently used for off-street parking. There is a concept plan being developed by the property owners to redevelop the site with retail and parking together with 40 residential units. If this number of units is realized, 6 affordable housing units would become available.
sites.notes: 4th Round Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area site. Mixed-use retail + 40 residential units; 6 affordable at 15% set-aside. No rezoning required. Concept plan only — no formal application filed.

sites.site_name: 36 Mt. Vernon Street (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area)
sites.source_page: pp. 16-17 (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan section)
sites.quote: 36 Mt. Vernon Street (Block 63 Lots 20 – 23) – 0 units. ... This parcel has site plan approval for retail shops and parking on the ground floor and 28 residential units on the upper floors. At the time of approval, the applicant was required to make payments to the Village Affordable Housing Trust Fund and not required to construct affordable units. ... no affordable credits have been taken at this time.
sites.notes: 4 lots; site plan approval already granted; required trust fund payment only (no affordable unit construction required per existing approval). 0 affordable credits. Could be revised if redeveloper amends plan. 28 residential units + retail.

sites.site_name: Disability Association of New Jersey (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area)
sites.address: Mt. Vernon Street (adjacent to 30 Mt. Vernon Street)
sites.source_page: pp. 17 (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan section)
sites.quote: Disability Association of New Jersey (Block 64 Lots 4, 15, 16) - 7 units. This property is located along Mt. Vernon Street adjacent to 30 Mt. Vernon Street Block 64 Lots 14, 15 and 16). It is approximately 0.5 acres and has 200 feet of frontage along Mt. Vernon Street.
sites.notes: Note: HEFSP title says 'Block 64 Lots 4, 15, 16' but the body text reads 'Block 64 Lots 14, 15 and 16' — likely a typo in the heading; Lots 14/15/16 per body text. Owned by non-profit; currently used to park transportation vans. Mixed-use retail/residential, 4 stories, 45-50 residential units possible; minimum 7 affordable at 15% set-aside. No rezoning required. No current development plan.

sites.site_name: Lincoln Court (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area)
sites.source_page: p. 17 (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan section)
sites.quote: Lincoln Court (Block 86 Lot 1) - 14 units. This property fronts on Lincoln Avenue, Spruce and Hobart Streets and currently has 22 duplex residential units on the site that were built in 1956 (Block 86 Lot 11). The redevelopment plan would permit multi-family residential development up to 4 stories in height. This could potentially yield up to 70 market units resulting in a minimum of 14 affordable residential units. No rezoning is required.
sites.notes: Current 22 duplex units built 1956 (Block 86 Lot 11). Redevelopment to 4-story multi-family; up to 70 total units, minimum 14 affordable (~20% set-aside). No rezoning required.

sites.site_name: Elks Club (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Area)
sites.source_page: pp. 17-18 (Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan section)
sites.quote: Elks Club (Block 96 Lot 1) – 16 units. The Elks Club property is located on Spruce and Cedar Streets (Block 96 Lot 1). It is 1 acre in size and presently has the organization's building and parking lot. ... R-4 zone criteria would result in approximately 80 multi-family units on the site of which a minimum of 16 units would be affordable. The Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan will be amended to include this property.
sites.notes: R-4 zone (multi-family, 7-story permitted); 1 acre; ~80 total units, minimum 16 affordable (20% set-aside). Mt. Vernon Street Redevelopment Plan amendment required to include this property. Backs to railroad; Cedar Street multi-family across street.

sites.site_name: Samsung Building, 85 Challenger Road (Challenger Road overlay)
sites.quote: Samsung Building, 85 Challenger Road (Block 24.03 Lot 3.01) - 30 units. This site is located in the Challenger Road Office/Residential Park along Overpeck Creek. ... The site is 6.3 acres in size and has an 8-story building with internal parking. The total building square footage is approximately 309,000 square feet. A conversion to residential apartments would yield approximately 250 units. A 20% affordable housing set aside would result in 50 affordable units on the site.
sites.notes: Note: header says 30 units but body text says 50 units at 20% of 250. Table 19 in distribution section also shows 30 units for Samsung — this appears to be a reduced estimate used in the distribution table; maximum potential is 50 at 20% of 250. Adaptive reuse via overlay zoning or Challenger Road Redevelopment Plan amendment. Current Samsung tenant vacating.

sites.site_name: AMC Theatre, 75 Challenger Road (Challenger Road overlay)
sites.quote: American Multi-Cenema, 75 Challenger Road (Block 24.03 Lot 3.02) – 28 units. The site currently contains a movie theatre complex with off-street parking on an adjacent lot. The property is 2.9 acres in size and can accommodate a total of 140 residential units ... A 20% affordable housing set aside would result in 28 affordable units on the site. A redevelopment amendment will be necessary to effectuate the housing development on this site.
sites.notes: Movie theatre complex; 2.9 acres; 140 residential units possible; 28 affordable at 20% set-aside. Challenger Road Redevelopment Plan amendment required.

sites.site_name: TD Bank Building (Mt. Vernon Street area)
sites.quote: TD Bank Bldg. (Block 75 Lots 5.01, 8) - 3 units. The TD bank building is located on Main Street at the northern edge of the downtown district (Block 75 Lots 5.01 and 8). The building was the principal four-story office for the bank but is now vacant. ... Approximately 20-25 apartments are possible with 3 affordable units. This development would be an adaptive reuse of the existing building.
sites.notes: Vacant 4-story bank building; C-1H zone permits residential above retail. 20-25 total apartments; 3 affordable. Adaptive reuse — no rezoning required.

sites.address: 78 Mt. Vernon Street (north side, east of Main Street)
sites.quote: 78 Mt. Vernon St. (Block 80 Lot 23) - 1 unit. This site is located along the north side of Mt. Vernon Street east of Main Street. (Block 80 Lot 23). The site contains an office building which was approved in 2022 to be converted to office space and 7 residential units in the C-1H zoning district. One of the residential units was designated as an affordable unit (2 bedroom). This site was not included in the Third Round Housing Plan and is now credited to the Fourth-Round obligation. No construction has commenced on the site to date, but approvals are still in effect and final plans are prepared.
sites.notes: Office building conversion approved in 2022; 7 total residential units; 1 affordable (2-BR). Approvals still in effect. No construction commenced. 4th Round credit. No rezoning required.
